title: Support
subtitle: Trouble during a trip, need to reschedule, or want to raise a complaint? These are XePrime's official contact channels.
draftNotice: The contact details below are still placeholders — fill in the real hotline, email, and staffed hours before the pilot opens.

channels.heading: Get in touch

hotline.label: Hotline
hotline.note: For incidents happening right now: breakdown, accident, or you cannot reach the other party.

email.label: Support email
email.note: For complaints, personal-data requests, and anything that needs documents attached.

hours.label: Staffed hours
hours.note: Outside these hours your request is still logged and picked up on the next shift.

channels.lead: These three channels are how XePrime receives requests. The actual contact details will be published before the marketplace opens properly.
channels.pendingNote: There is no official phone number, email or staffed-hours window yet. We leave them blank rather than publish contact details nobody answers.

beforeContact.heading: Include these so we can help faster
beforeContact.phone: The phone number registered to your account
beforeContact.evidence: Vehicle condition photos, the handover report, and related messages
beforeContact.expectation: What you want: reschedule, cancel, refund, or technical help

emergency.heading: In an emergency
emergency.body: If there is an accident or a risk to life, call 113 (police), 114 (fire), or 115 (ambulance) first. Tell XePrime and the vehicle owner once you are safe.

scope.heading: What XePrime can and cannot do
scope.canDo: We can provide the trip record held in our system, help the two sides reach each other, act on breaches of the marketplace rules, and receive complaints.
scope.cannotDo: For any part of a deal the two sides arranged off the platform, we hold no data to reconcile and cannot promise a refund or adjudicate it.

legal.heading: Terms and policies
legal.body: The rights and obligations of each party are set out in the documents below.

topics.heading: Answers already written up
topics.lead: Most questions are answered on the pages below.

how.title: How booking works

cancel.desc: The free-cancellation deadline, what is refunded at each stage, and who is responsible.

start.desc: The two ways to join, the records you need, and the review before a vehicle goes live.

rules.desc: A shop's obligations, prohibited behaviour, and how the platform handles breaches.
